articles.title: U.S. and Iran Exchange Fire Amid a Declared Truce
articles.summary: Iran will respond to a US peace proposal through Pakistan. An Iranian official said that Tehran would convey its reply through Pakistan, a key mediator. Another Iranian official had earlier dismissed a reported proposal to end the war as a “list of American wishes.”.

articles.title: Federal court rules against new global tariffs Trump imposed after loss at Supreme Court
articles.summary: A federal court ruled against Trump's new global tariffs, finding the 10% tariffs illegal. The Court of International Trade in New York made the decision. A split three-judge panel of the Court of International Trade in New York on Thursday (May 7, 2026) found the 10% global tariffs were illegal after small businesses sued.

articles.title: US court deals fresh blow to Trump's 10% global tariff policy
articles.summary: A US federal court said President Trump overstepped his authority with the 10% global tariff policy. The court dealt a fresh blow to Trump's policy. A US federal court said President Donald Trump overstepped his authority when he invoked a section of a 1974 trade law to enact the 10% global tariff policy.

articles.title: Huge fire at Mexican fair kills five people

articles.summary: US President Trump has given the European Union until July 4 to enact a trade deal agreed last year and drop tariffs on American goods to zero. The deal was agreed upon in 2021, but the EU has yet to meet its commitments.
